description: SEC Schedule TO tender offers: SC TO-T (third-party bid for a company's shares), SC TO-I (issuer buyback) and their /A amendments. One row per filing, metadata only; offer terms are at primary_document_url. An amendment chain shares file_number (a field, not a filter). since/until (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on filing_date), target_name and bidder_name apply within the newest max(500, 4 x limit) filings the other filters select, 2,000 with a name filter; coverage_warning says so.
